verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs mention generic audit logging, including an enterprise Audit Logs feature, and an official MCP server exists. However, no evidence shows Gitea records or audits AI agent sessions or attributes agent actions to the user who triggered them. Generic audit logging is an adjacent feature and does not earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can audit AI agent sessions and actions attributed to the user who triggered them

citations.quote: offering features such as user permission management, access control lists, audit logging, and more to ensure the security of code and data.
